dialogues.speaker: Inkanak
dialogues.text: Sure enough, working together with capable people lets us meet new challenges.

dialogues.speaker: Inkanak
dialogues.text: I am the manager of the flight trial grounds, and I'm involved in organizing much of the work that gets done here.

dialogues.speaker: Inkanak
dialogues.text: The arena's a very important place for the Flower-Feather Clan. In my heart, its importance is second only to the totem pole.

dialogues.speaker: Inkanak
dialogues.text: After all, the fate of many a flying squad member or associate member is determined here.

dialogues.speaker: Inkanak
dialogues.text: That's how a person's fate is. Sometimes up, sometimes down, like the undulating wind. But if I could, I'd love to be the breeze beneath everyone's wings.

dialogues.speaker: Inkanak
dialogues.text: Welcome back to the Flower-Feather Clan. Everything's going well here!

dialogues.speaker: Inkanak
dialogues.text: We were in a rough spot before, but good thing we had formidable folks like you and Chasca around — it all worked out in the end.

dialogues.speaker: Inkanak
dialogues.text: I also get that some of my proposals are a little too focused on efficiency over safety...

dialogues.speaker: Inkanak
dialogues.text: But somehow, they always wind up getting picked up and implemented by people like yourself, so I guess I'm just lucky like that.

dialogues.speaker: Inkanak
dialogues.text: Are you saying that it's human nature to tackle challenges head-on?
